_comment: g-gate-ratchet lives inside run-gates.mjs, not as a gate. It counts ONLY gates whose declared inputPaths[] all exist and are non-empty AND which have >= 1 verdict-flipping mutation, so a gate cannot be created early to inflate the count and a gate that cannot fail was never in it. Lowering `minGates` is legal only in a commit citing a DECISIONS.md row beginning 'Gate removal:'.
